learning_outcomes.text: Can identify types of occupational accidents, determine scientific and observation-based measures that can be taken before an accident occurs, investigate an occupational accident, determine the fault ratios of parties in an occupational accident, determine the disability rate in an occupational accident, determine authorities and responsibilities when working as a production manager in the workplace, learn methods to prevent occupational accidents and interpret interesting applications selected from working life, and prepare an expert report.
